requirements:
# Scientific/conformance environment only; not a runtime dependency or dynamic install hook.
numpy==1.26.4
cryptography==50.0.2
workflow_head:
external-evidence-contract:
    name: external-evidence-contract
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact candidate
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify immutable source identity
        run: python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py --kind head --expected-head "$TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-observations/source.json"
      - name: Set isolated Cargo paths after runner allocation
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          printf 'CARGO_HOME=%s/cargo-%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" "$GITHUB_JOB" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'CARGO_TARGET_DIR=%s/target-%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" "$GITHUB_JOB" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR=%s/ci-observations\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Install isolated evidence-replay Python environment
        run: |
          python3 -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/pon-evidence-env"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/pon-evidence-env/bin/python" -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --only-binary=:all: -r formal/pon-nakamoto-v1/requirements.txt
          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/pon-evidence-env/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - name: Run actual external-evidence-contract checks
        run: bash scripts/ci/ci_job.sh external-evidence-contract
      - name: Verify source remained unchanged
        if: always()
        run: python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py --kind head --expected-head "$TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA"
      - name: Retain source and execution observations
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: head-${{ github.job }}-${{ env.TRNM_EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/ci-observations/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
